title: TeleEmbedBench: A Multi-Corpus Embedding Benchmark for RAG in Telecommunications
why_relevant: Introduces a domain-specific embedding benchmark with a noisy-query subset (TeleEmbedBench-Clean) to test robustness against incomplete user queries and cross-domain interference.
why_not_or_caveat: Primarily a telecom-domain embedding benchmark; robustness aspects are narrow and secondary, not focused on the broader robust-RAG concerns of conflict, adversaries, or calibration.
suggested_section: Evaluation and benchmarks for noisy retrieval
